trello.name: Implement queue depth alerts for worker fleets
trello.desc: Create alerting for queue depth spikes across the entire worker fleet, not just payment workers. Set warning threshold at 1,000 jobs and paging threshold at 5,000 jobs. Owner: Kofi.

trello.name: Fix retry logic in payment worker
trello.desc: Revise the retry logic in payment_worker.py _process_with_retry function to implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap the number of retries, and ensure failed jobs go to a dead-letter queue at the back instead of the front of the main queue. Add tests simulating processor 503 errors. Owner: Marta.

trello.name: Increase and split DB connection pools
trello.desc: Increase the database connection pool size from 20 to 100 connections. Separate the worker and API database connection pools to avoid resource contention. Implement both changes together in the same configuration file. Owner: Kofi.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Update the payment incident runbook to replace old Kibana links with new logging links, document the queue drain procedure improvised during the outage, and verify that escalation phone numbers are current. Assign to Priya to perform the update, confirmed by Kofi.

trello.name: Automate status page updates on alerts
trello.desc: Automate the status page update process to trigger automatically when the checkout error rate alert fires. The status page should switch to an investigating state using a template message without manual intervention. Begin with the checkout alert, extendable to other alerts later. Owner: Marta.

trello.name: Plan and review payment processor failover game day
trello.desc: Draft a detailed plan for a game day to test payment processor failover in staging first, then production during a low-traffic window, including a rollback plan. Review the plan in two weeks before execution. Owner: Kofi.

trello.name: Schedule Redis upgrade to version 7.2
trello.desc: Plan and schedule an upgrade of Redis from version 6.0 (EOL) to 7.2, accounting for config renames and changes in persistence defaults. Perform the upgrade during a proper change window, not casual Friday deployments. Owner: Kofi, coordinate with infrastructure calendar.
